name: io.github.publicaml/mcp-server
description: Screen a crypto address for AML risk, trace where its money came from or went, and list its counterparties. Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, Tron.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLICAML_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server works anonymously under an IP rate limit and outgoing tracing is unavailable.

environmentVariables.name: PUBLICAML_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the API base URL. Default https://intelapi.publicaml.org
